experiment: E90, the new-against-reuse definition as a procedure
rules_code: experiments/new_vs_reuse/rules.py; edge cases in tests/test_new_vs_reuse.py, no model
comparisons: Strict throughout: x above a band means x > band; a share equal to the band is not above. nan is never above and is counted; a nan band reads no call. C counts only if the best g's accuracy > the floor; a tie is not admissible.

settings.block_note: Block b reads block b's output residual (readout.RESID[b]). Block 0 sits upstream of the hand write in block 1 and is printed only, for the readout. Block 3 is the last and never b*.
settings.band: removal.band_of over the 20 random bases of the same rank, per state; removal.max_band over every state read at that C and block

readout.fit_bar_note: The plan's bar, read as written: an absolute 1.37 on the last block's held-out loss; a miss or nan stops. It is E64's number on E64's 64 values (model 1.27 + 0.10). E64 itself read 1.44 there and recorded it, it did not stop. Model at the sample's prior is printed beside.

pile.source: E64's rows, caps and unfit bar

guess_scan.note: W0's argmax is read at indices 20-40 of random 41-token spans to find candidates, then each candidate is re-cut with it at index 20 (E64's context length) and kept if W0's argmax there is still one of the values. At most 2 x cap candidates per value.

settings.unfit_values: A value with under unfit_below fit windows leaves the readout and the basis; rank = fit values - 1; listed in the log

token identity.X_C: natural occurrences of the keys at index 20 of Pile windows, E64's rows
token identity.teeth_reads: W0's log-odds, at X_C, that the next token is the current token

W0's next-word guess.f_C: W0's argmax next token, one of the 18 values of the full 32-key rank-1 table
W0's next-word guess.teeth_reads: W0's log-odds of its own guess at X_C, held rows

in-context copying.f_C: the token that followed the earlier occurrence of the current token
in-context copying.form: mechanism: head (2,4) mean-ablated, copying.ablated, means from heads.pt; 20 random single heads for the band

W0's graded leaning (R7).f_C: W0's log-odds of ' was' at the position
W0's graded leaning (R7).X_C: natural occurrences of ' which' at index 20 of Pile windows, E64's rows
W0's graded leaning (R7).b_star_note: The plan gives R7 no possession rule for a scalar and no block. Filed: block 1, the first after the push, as token identity; block 2 printed beside and not scored.

admissibility.g_class: identity and a table over the values seen in the fit half; constant = the floor. No filed C has a further text rule without a fitted parameter
admissibility.split: Parity over the task's keys in its key order, or over windows for a constant answer. E62's pair: fit = train-side windows, read = read-side windows, because A7's reason (read-side Bs are disjoint from train-side Bs) is a statement about those halves. The parity split inside the read windows is printed beside and is not the filed reading

A1.rule: best g > floor, on rand32's keys
A1.on_edge: floor 0 and best 0 is a tie: not admissible

A3.case: constant answer: rand1, emoticon, ladder rungs, many-to-one, lowercase as its scored pair
A3.rule: the answer has one value over all inputs; every g ties the floor
A3.on_edge: rand1 is read over its windows, so it has both halves

A4.rule: identity 1.0 > floor; the count of keys holding the commonest token is printed

A5.rule: identity ties the floor. Being constant it also carries the label 'definition does not apply', A3's mechanism; the plan's two rows name one case twice

A7.rule: best g > floor, train-side to read-side

A8.rule: identity on B > floor, train-side to read-side

A9.rule: either half empty: not admissible, accuracies nan, printed as such

admissibility.pairs_note: Row 6 of the plan's table lists no C: its pairs check that none would have counted. T15's twin has no filed verdict and is printed. T8 is structural: any derangement, since its table needs Pile ranks and the tokenizer and every derangement reads the same on a parity split

R1.rule: rules.verdict on a nan share under the gain floor; it cannot pass

R2.case: ident32_s0, rand32_s0, ident32's hand write, C = token identity, value form, b* = 1
R2.rule: rules.r2: as filed iff verdict(ident32, write) is not specific, rand32 > band, and max - min of the three shares is not > band
R2.branch: cipher spared: ident32 > band and rand32 <= band; token identity is specific and copy reads by its share
R2.on_nan: a nan share, band or failed match: a miss

R3.case: rank1_s0 and the rank-1 hand write at matched gain, C = W0's guess, value form, b* in {1, 2}; cipher_s0 read beside
branches: hand write spared: its share <= band; rank-1 read by its own share
no readout: no block possessed; rows 2-3 read 'unreadable: no readout'
R3.on_nan: a nan share, band or failed match: a miss

R4.case: E70 A1's saved P and N shares under D
R4.filed: unreadable: not specific at every block
R4.rule: rules.all_pairs on P_10000 x N_10000 per block with the row's band and R1's teeth

R5.case: E62's saved copy and lookup, mechanism form
R5.rule: rules.verdict per seed: copy against lookup, lookup against copy. Stage 0 checks the mapping with no W0 reading (teeth taken as true, marked so) and the band from E62's 5 saved random_shares per state; stage 2 measures W0's teeth and the band on 20 random heads
R5.beside: E62's filed verdict 'copy_not_elicitation', reading 'mixed', stands; E90's 'reuses C' is a different rule's reading beside it

R6.case: share equal to the band; partner gain under the floor

R7.case: ladder r1_t534_v369 fine-tune, seed 0, step 10, and a hand-written constant push at matched gain, C = W0's graded leaning
R7.rule: rules.r7 at block 1; the push is perturb.key_write with K = 1 on the trigger's input, matched with write_rel_tol
R7.branch: push <= band and state > band: the leaning form is usable and the user decides whether constant-target tasks get read on their old states; A3 stands until they do
R7.on_nan: a nan share, band or failed match: a miss

what_a_miss_does: The definition is frozen at decisions.md rows 81 and 115 (plan, 'Scope as restated', 2026-11-05). A miss outside the branches on R2, R3 or R7, or no teeth on W0, is reported as a gap and changes nothing here. Stage 2 reads the full table whatever R3 reads. Only the early_stops below stop a job.

assumed_labels.T7 lowercase: reuses, the model already writes it
assumed_labels.T15 class map: a new rule that carries, open

verdict_rule: rules.verdict, per (task, C, b*): no teeth; nan state share 'no gain'; nan control, nan band or failed match 'no call'; then the 2 x 2. No size bar on 'reuses C': the verdict prints its share. Seeds one by one: the verdict every seed gives, else 'mixed'

expected_numbers.readout_accuracy: at least 0.75 at some block <= 2; shuffled about 1/18

early_stops: a state or windows file whose sha256 differs from its saved record
limit: Every claim states the granularity limit: a circuit from old parts reads as reuse.
